entities.name: Francisco Vargas Peláez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Javier Vargas Peláez is a Mexican professional boxer, also known for his nickname "El Bandido." As an amateur, Vargas represented Mexico at the 2008 Summer Olympics as a lightweight. He held the WBC super featherweight title between 2015 and 2017.
